newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.

text.p: Five stocks fell, four rose and four were flat in 6.9-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Tuesday with the WIG 20 index closing at 1,591.7 points, 0.5 percent lower than at the regular session.
The remaining 10 stocks did not trade.
NFI units fell 0.7 percent to 152 zlotys in a 22.5-million-zloty turnover.
For more details Reuter-terminal users can double-click on WSECONT. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
